==Description==
'''Flipping Burgers''' is an emote that could be obtained at Level 28 of the premium [[Surf & Turf Battle Pass]]. It was made by Capra. The player cannot move or interact with the emote. No music can be heard while performing the emote and the emote is looped.

'''Flipping Burgers''' will cause a grill to appear, with a few burger on it. The player will occasionally flip them with a spatula.

It has a cost of {{BeachBalls|940}} or {{Robux|108}} to unlock it, with a total cost of {{BeachBalls|12,510}} or {{Robux|2,191}}. This item also has had two other costs. First one was the cost before its 20% discount, which had a cost of {{Robux|136}} with a total cost of {{Robux|2,754}}. The second was the price prior to the [[Surf & Turf Battle Pass]] individual skip cost fix, where it had a cost of {{Robux|86}}, with a total cost of {{Robux|2,152}}.
